complete_examples.text: It is closely related to factors such as train loads, the fastening system, sleeper geometry, type and weight of sleepers, type of ballast, the thickness and consolidation of the ballast layer, and maintenance services.

Note that, since this paper primarily focuses on investigating the lateral resistance characteristics of the ballast to sleeper lateral movement, the DEM model in this work does not take the rail and fastening system into consideration.
